description: This file defines data models for multimodal content (text, image, audio, file) using Pydantic, including methods to create these models from local files or URLs, with support for base64 encoding and MIME type detection.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Represents text content in a multimodal prompt.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents image content in a multimodal prompt, with methods to create from file or URL.

classes.name: Audio
classes.description: Represents audio content in a multimodal prompt, with methods to create from file or URL.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a generic file in a multimodal prompt, with methods to create from file or URL.

methods.name: from_file
methods.description: Create Image, Audio, or File object from local file, encoding content to base64 and detecting MIME type.

methods.name: from_url
methods.description: Create Image, Audio, or File object from URL, optionally downloading and encoding content.
